summary.headline: The Southborough Library Board of Trustees reviewed the FY28 operating budget preview and discussed network policies regarding de-certified libraries.
summary.summary: The Library Board of Trustees met on October 5, 2026, to review administrative reports, discuss the preliminary FY28 operating budget, and examine CWMARS library certification policies. The director shared updates regarding facility lighting, security cables, and book drop locations. The board also held an in-depth discussion on maintaining state certification requirements and managing library material budgets.

topics.title: Approval of meeting minutes
topics.summary: The board reviewed and approved the minutes from the September 14 meeting with minor corrections.
key_details: Reviewed edits for the September 14 meeting minutes.

topics.title: Director's report
topics.summary: The library director provided updates on facility lighting improvements, book drop relocation, and security cable installations for electronic game consoles.
key_details: Book drop was relocated near the recycling area on the lawn due to its heavy weight.
Security cables were installed for console controllers to prevent items from disappearing.
Lighting adjustments and ongoing maintenance items were reviewed.

topics.title: FY28 operating budget preview
topics.summary: The board examined the preliminary FY28 operating budget, discussing staff longevity payouts, material and book expenditures, and CWMARS assessments.
key_details: Reviewed comparison data between FY27 and FY28 budget projections.
Discussed the impact of staff longevity payouts on salary line items.
Emphasized the importance of meeting state materials expenditure requirements to maintain certification.
topics.why_it_matters: Budget decisions directly impact library operating hours, staffing levels, and the acquisition of books and materials for residents.

topics.title: CWMARS de-certified libraries policy discussion
topics.summary: The board discussed CWMARS network policies concerning libraries that lose state certification and how network rules impact borrowing privileges and reciprocal lending.
key_details: Reviewed a list of libraries in the region that are currently de-certified or non-compliant.
Discussed how network rules restrict borrowing privileges for patrons of de-certified libraries.

topics.title: Routine business and adjournment
topics.summary: The board discussed upcoming book sale volunteer needs, confirmed the next meeting date, and voted to adjourn.
key_details: Volunteers requested for the upcoming book sale.

votes.motion: Motion to approve the budget as presented

upcoming.what: Next Library Board of Trustees meeting
